caption: The video captures a frosty canal on a clear, partly cloudy morning, with a largely stationary viewpoint down the waterway. A frost-covered towpath runs along the left bank, while the right bank is lined with several moored narrowboats, including a cream-and-blue covered hull, a dark-hulled boat, and a grey boat with an orange panel, all mirrored in the still water. Behind them sit a large green hedge and bare winter trees. Far down the canal on the left, a dark narrowboat faces the camera, and a thin plume of smoke rises continuously from its chimney, drifting leftward and reshaping itself from frame to frame. This emission is the clearest ongoing process in the scene. The distant boat holds essentially the same position relative to the bank and its own reflection throughout. The water surface and the boat and tree reflections stay largely stable, showing only minor shimmer. A faint aircraft contrail crosses the upper sky as a thin diagonal streak.
